title: Answer and ask adj records in ork

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Closes parity rows 6.2 and 4.3 and the "Answer and ask adj records in ork" gap (docs/orchestrator-parity.md, sections 4 and 6; the Prioritized gaps table, gap 7), the adjcli, engine, daemon and CLI half. Today ork calls `adj check`, `ask` and `decide --by` only when a role's question carries a decision key and the owner turned filing on (`internal/engine/answer_adj.go:34-60`, `internal/adjcli/adjcli.go:111-154`). The owner answers an open record, or asks a new one, in another session.

Split on 2026-10-29: this slice is the adjcli functions, the engine functions, the daemon methods and the two CLI commands. The TUI answer keys and confirmation (the decision pane's `1`-`4` and `t` keys) are S185, which depends on this slice.

Depends on adj `scope.v1-ork-edits` (adj 173, open): do not start this slice, or S185, until the owner has decided it.

Owner decisions 2026-10-29:
- This gap is v1.0 (everything except S173, S179 and S180 is).
- ork answers an adj record with `adj decide --by <owner> --why <text that cites ork, the surface and the date>`, and only for an option or a typed answer the owner gave in a prompt that names it. ork never runs `adj reject`, `adj supersede` or `adj withdraw` (`process.owner-answers`, #170; `AGENTS.md`, Decisions). `internal/adjcli/adjcli.go` has no function for any of them, and this slice adds none.
- `ork adj ask` is CLI only (no TUI ask form). `ork adj answer` always prompts and has no `--yes`: an agent that ran it with `--yes` would decide for the owner, which `process.owner-answers` forbids.

Facts checked on 2026-10-29:
- `adj ask TITLE [--option LABEL:SUMMARY]... [--tradeoffs LABEL:TEXT]... [--recommend LABEL] [--reasoning TEXT] [--key K] [--tag T]... [--ref R]... [--context TEXT] [--by NAME]` prints the new id. `adj decide ID OPTION --why TEXT [--by NAME]` takes one of the record's option labels, or `--text TEXT` for a free answer. `adj show ID --json` prints one record. `adj check QUERY` gives `decided`, `open`, `closed` or `not found` on line 1. (`adj ask --help`, `adj decide --help`, `adj show --help`, `adj check --help`, read 2026-10-29.)
- `Client.Ask` (`adjcli.go:137-148`) sends only title, key, one ref, context and `--by`; it has no options. `Client.Decide` (`adjcli.go:150-154`) sends only `--text`. Both stay as they are for `fileDecision`; this slice adds siblings.
- The owner's name comes from the caller's `ADJ_DECIDED_BY`, sent over the wire as `by` (`internal/tui/model.go:1391`, `internal/cli/wave.go:256`). The daemon refuses a decide without it (`internal/daemon/runs.go:915-917`).
- `docs/boundaries.md:70-73`: `adj decide` runs only on an explicit owner action, as the owner. This slice keeps that: no role and no automatic step calls the new methods.
- Before asking, check (`AGENTS.md`, Decisions): a keyed ask runs `adj check KEY` first and stops on `decided`, `open` or `closed`.

Decided records that apply: `scope.v1` (#1) says roadmap and decision editing wait for a later version; the owner's 2026-10-29 decision moves this gap into v1.0, and the owner records that against #1.

What this slice adds (all *proposed* until an adj record decides it):
- adjcli: `Show`, `AskQuestion` (options, tradeoffs, recommendation, refs, tags) and `DecideOption`.
- engine: `AnswerRecord` and `AskRecord` as package functions in `internal/engine/adjrecord.go` (new), beside `fileDecision`.
- Daemon methods `adj.answer` and `adj.ask`; the project must use adj. After either, the Open and Decided parts are read again.
- `ork adj answer PROJECT ID (--option LABEL | --text TEXT)`: prints the question and options, then asks `Decide #ID as LABEL in adj as NAME? [y/N]`. Enter and closed input are No. There is no `--yes`.
- `ork adj ask PROJECT TITLE [--key K] [--context TEXT|-] [--option LABEL:SUMMARY]... [--tradeoffs LABEL:TEXT]... [--recommend LABEL] [--reasoning TEXT] [--ref R]... [--tag T]...`: no prompt, because asking decides nothing.

Not in this slice: the TUI answer keys and confirmation (S185), a TUI form to ask a new record, `adj amend`, `withdraw`, `reject` and `supersede` (the owner runs those), answering a record of a project that does not use adj, and filing a role question in adj (that is `fileDecision`, unchanged).

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `TestAdjClientShowAskAndDecideOption` (`internal/adjcli/adjcli_test.go`): `Show` runs `show ID --json --root R`; `AskQuestion` builds `ask TITLE --key K --context C --option a:A --option b:B --tradeoffs a:T --recommend a --reasoning R --ref X --by NAME` and returns the id; `DecideOption` builds `decide ID LABEL --why W --by NAME`. A source scan of `adjcli.go` finds no `"reject"`, `"supersede"` or `"withdraw"` argument.
- `TestAnswerRecordPicksAnOptionOrTypesText` (`internal/engine/adjrecord_test.go`): an option label runs `decide ID LABEL`; `Text` runs `decide ID --text T`; the `--why` names ork, the surface (`tui` or `cli`) and the date from `Deps.Now`; `--by` is the caller's name.
- `TestAnswerRecordRefusals` (`internal/engine/adjrecord_test.go`): blank `by`, both or neither of option and text, a label that is not in the record's options, and a record that is not open each stop before any `decide` call, with the record's status in the message.
- `TestAskRecordChecksTheKeyBeforeAsking` (`internal/engine/adjrecord_test.go`): a key that `adj check` reports as `decided`, `open` or `closed` refuses with the record id and makes no `ask` call; `not found` asks; no key skips the check.
- `TestAskRecordRefusals` (`internal/engine/adjrecord_test.go`): blank title, one option, five options, a recommendation that is not an option label, and `--reasoning` without a recommendation are refused before any call.
- `TestAdjMethodsDecideAskAndRefresh` (`internal/daemon/adjwrite_test.go`): `adj.answer` and `adj.ask` run through the fake adj, then the Open and Decided parts are read again; subtests: a project without adj gives `bad_params`, an unknown project `not_found`, an unknown field `bad_params`, and an adj error keeps its text and hides argv (as `answerError`, `adjcli.go:156-162`).
- `TestAdjAnswerCommandConfirmsBeforeDeciding` (`internal/cli/adj_test.go`): the command prints the record's title and options, then the prompt; `y` calls `adj.answer` once; `n`, Enter and closed input call nothing and exit 0 with `cancelled`; a record not in the project's open list exits 1; `ADJ_DECIDED_BY` unset exits 1 before the prompt; there is no `--yes` flag.
- `TestAdjAskCommand` (`internal/cli/adj_test.go`): `ork adj ask P "Title" --key a.b --option x:X --option y:Y --recommend x --reasoning R` sends the params and prints the new id; `--json` prints `{"id":12}`; a key `adj check` knows exits 1 with the existing id; bad `--option` text (no colon) exits 2.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
UI slice: UI pass (r14), because the new `ork adj answer` and `ork adj ask` commands change `internal/cli` output. No `internal/tui` change in this slice. Write the failing tests first.

1. `internal/adjcli/adjcli.go`: add `Client.Show(ctx, root, id int) (*Record, error)` (`adj show ID --json --root R`, a read like `Inbox`, `adjcli.go:88`), `AskSpec{Title, Key, Context, By, Recommend, Reasoning string; Options []AskOption; Refs, Tags []string}` with `AskOption{Label, Summary, Tradeoffs string}`, `Client.AskQuestion(ctx, w, root, spec) (int, error)`, and `Client.DecideOption(ctx, w, root, id int, label, why, by string) error`. Build them on `c.write` (`adjcli.go:104-109`) and decode the id as `Ask` does (`adjcli.go:137-148`); keep `answerError` (`adjcli.go:156-162`) around every result so argv stays out of messages. Add no reject, supersede or withdraw function.
2. `internal/engine/adjrecord.go` (new, SPDX line first): `AnswerRecordConfig{Project registry.Project; ID int; Option, Text, By, Via string}` and `AnswerRecord(ctx, d Deps, cfg) (string, error)`. Order: `by` not blank; exactly one of Option and Text; `d.Adj.Show`; status must be `open`; an Option must equal one option label exactly. `why` = `"Answered in ork (" + Via + ") on " + date + ": " + record.Title`. Then `DecideOption` or `Decide` (`adjcli.go:150`). Return `"decided in adj as #ID"` as `fileDecision` does (`answer_adj.go:55-60`). Also `AskRecordConfig` and `AskRecord(ctx, d Deps, cfg) (id int, err error)`: validate (title; 0 options, or 2-4; recommend names an option; reasoning needs a recommend), then with a key run `d.Adj.Check` (`adjcli.go:111`) and refuse any state but `not found`, then `AskQuestion`. Use `runrec.Writer{Now: d.now, Sleep: d.Sleep, Backoff: d.Backoff}` with no Sink (`speccheck.go:373`).
3. `internal/daemon/wire.go:17-33` and `internal/daemon/adjwrite.go` (new): `MethodAdjAnswer = "adj.answer"` and `MethodAdjAsk = "adj.ask"` (*proposed*); `AdjAnswerParams{Project string; ID int; Option, Text, By, Via string}` with result `{Message string}`; `AdjAskParams` (title, key, context, options, recommend, reasoning, refs, tags, by) with result `{ID int}`. Handlers: `d.registered` (`reads.go:77`), refuse `!proj.Adj` with `badParams`, call the engine function with `d.runDeps(proj)` (`runs.go:159`), then `d.cache.Refresh(ctx, proj, source.Open, source.Decided)`. Dispatch in `handlers.go:61-170`; `Client.AdjAnswer` and `Client.AdjAsk` beside `AnswerAction` (`client.go:284-296`). S185 calls `Client.AdjAnswer` with `Via` set to `tui`.
4. `internal/cli/adj.go` (new): `ork adj answer` and `ork adj ask` as in Why. `answer` reads the project's open records from `snapshot` (`daemon.MethodSnapshot`, `SnapshotResult.Open`, `wire.go:218-231`) to print the title and options, then prompts on `a.Input` the way `ork run` does (`run.go:67-98`; Enter and closed input are No, a No prints `cancelled` and exits 0). `by` = `ADJ_DECIDED_BY` for answer; for ask `ADJ_ASKED_BY`, else `ADJ_DECIDED_BY`, else empty (adj accepts an empty asker). `Via` is `cli`. Usage text and dispatch: `cli.go:40-77`, `cli.go:173-205`.
5. Docs: `docs/design.md:1205-1240` (the `adj answer` and `adj ask` commands, `adj.answer` and `adj.ask`, and that `answer` has no `--yes`), `docs/boundaries.md:70-73` (the explicit owner action now also covers answering a record in ork; still no reject, supersede or withdraw). The TUI text in `docs/dashboard.md` is S185.

Order: after the owner decides adj 173 (`scope.v1-ork-edits`). S185 depends on this slice. It shares `cli.go` with S170 and S171 and with S166 to S169; merge main before the gate.
